Name: The microprocessor
Text: A whole processor on one chip is announced. Engineers everywhere start asking what else could be put on a single die.

Name: Calculator price war
Text: Pocket calculators fall below $100 and sales explode: demand for calculator chips is up {share} for about {months} months.

Name: Oil crisis
Text: An oil embargo throws the world into recession. Chip demand falls {share} across the board for about {months} months.

Name: Oil crisis prices
Text: Energy and chemical prices soar with the oil embargo: wafer materials cost {share} more for about {months} months.

Name: Home computers arrive
Text: Three ready-built home computers go on sale in the same year. Every maker wants a cheap, capable processor.

Name: Second oil shock
Text: Revolution in Iran sends oil prices up again: wafer materials cost {share} more for about {months} months.

Name: 1980 recession
Text: Interest rates near 20% bring a short recession: demand down {share} for about {months} months.

Name: 1981 recession
Text: A deeper recession takes hold. Chip demand falls {share} for about {months} months.

Name: Video game crash
Text: Stores are drowning in unsold games and consoles. The console market is collapsing.

Name: Home computer price war
Text: {rival} slashes prices as home computer makers fight to the bottom.

Name: Demand boom
Text: A hit product drives up demand for {segment} chips by {share} for about {months} months.

Name: Demand slump
Text: Buyers of {segment} chips are sitting on stock: demand is down {share} for about {months} months.

Name: Materials shortage
Text: A shortage of high-purity chemicals and silicon: wafer materials cost {share} more for about {months} months.
